query:
INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, actor_id, event_id, kind)
           SELECT h.user_id, $2, h.event_id, ($3::text)::notification_kind
           FROM event_hosts h
           WHERE h.event_id = $1
             AND h.user_id <> $2
             AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM event_mutes m
               WHERE m.user_id = h.user_id AND m.event_id = h.event_id
             )
